desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal An ASMR!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from pets
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare ASMRs
👷 Buy Workers to earn money from your ASMRs
💰 Use your money to upgrade and grow your base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
